cues: Lie back with your eyes under the bar, feet flat, shoulder blades pinched together
Lower the bar to your mid-chest with your forearms vertical
Press up and slightly back until your arms are straight
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your chest
Lifting your hips off the bench

cues: Start with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing forward
Lower until your upper arms are about level with the bench
Press up without letting the dumbbells clank together
mistakes: Flaring your elbows straight out to the sides
Letting the dumbbells drift out of line with your shoulders

cues: Set the bench to a low incline, about 30 degrees
Keep your shoulder blades pinched back against the pad
Press the dumbbells up and slightly together over your upper chest
mistakes: Setting the bench so steep that it turns into a shoulder press
Arching your lower back off the bench

cues: Put your hands just wider than your shoulders and keep your body in one straight line
Lower until your chest is about a fist's height from the floor
Push the floor away and keep your core tight
mistakes: Letting your hips sag or pike up
Flaring your elbows out to 90 degrees

cues: Place your hands about one and a half times shoulder width apart
Lower under control until your chest nearly touches the floor
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels
mistakes: Going so wide that your shoulders feel pinched
Only doing half reps

cues: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest
Keep your back and head flat against the pad
Press until your arms are almost straight, then return slowly
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears
Letting the weight stack slam back down

cues: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and step forward into a split stance
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and sweep your hands together in front of your chest
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest
mistakes: Bending your elbows more and more until it becomes a press
Swinging your body to move the handles

cues: Set the seat so the handles sit at chest height
Keep your chest up and your shoulder blades back against the pad
Bring the handles together in front of you, then return slowly
mistakes: Letting your shoulders roll forward
Opening your arms further back than is comfortable

cues: Grip the bars and lean your torso forward slightly
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor
Press up until your elbows are straight
mistakes: Dropping so deep that your shoulders hurt
Staying fully upright, which shifts the work to your triceps

cues: Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders, palms facing away
Start each rep by pulling your shoulder blades down
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower fully
mistakes: Kicking or swinging to get up
Cutting the range short at the bottom

cues: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders and lean back slightly
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight
mistakes: Leaning far back and swinging the weight
Pulling the bar behind your neck

cues: Sit tall with your knees slightly bent and your chest up
Pull the handle to your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together
Let your arms extend slowly without rounding your back
mistakes: Rocking your torso back and forth
Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears

cues: Set the seat so you can reach the handles with your chest against the pad
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together
Return slowly until your arms are straight
mistakes: Pulling with your arms only instead of your back
Letting your shoulders roll forward at the end of each rep

cues: Hinge at your hips with a flat back until your torso is about 45 degrees
Pull the bar to your lower ribs and keep your elbows close
Lower under control without letting your back round
mistakes: Standing up on every rep to heave the weight
Rounding your lower back

cues: Hinge forward with a flat back and the dumbbells hanging under your shoulders
Row both dumbbells toward your hips
Lower slowly to a full stretch
mistakes: Jerking the weight up with your torso
Looking up and straining your neck

cues: Rest one hand and the same-side knee on a flat bench with your back flat
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, not your chest
Lower until your arm is fully straight
mistakes: Twisting your torso to lift the weight
Pulling the dumbbell straight up to your shoulder

cues: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip just outside your legs
Brace your core, keep your back flat and push the floor away
Stand tall, then lower the bar back down along your legs
mistakes: Rounding your lower back
Jerking the bar off the floor instead of pulling the slack out first

cues: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together and squeeze your back
Hold for a second, then lower slowly
mistakes: Cranking your neck up to look forward
Using momentum instead of holding the top

cues: Lie face down with your arms at your sides, palms down
Lift your chest slightly and sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead
Reverse the arc slowly back to your sides
mistakes: Letting your arms drop to the floor between reps
Arching your lower back hard to get higher

cues: Hold the bar at your collarbones with your elbows just in front of it
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core, then press the bar straight up
Move your head forward through the gap once the bar passes your forehead
mistakes: Leaning back until it turns into an incline press
Flaring your ribs and arching your lower back

cues: Start with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward
Press up until your arms are straight above your shoulders
Lower to ear level under control
mistakes: Arching your back to push the weight up
Pressing the dumbbells forward instead of straight up

cues: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height
Keep your back against the pad and press straight up
Lower slowly until your elbows are level with your shoulders
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up as you press
Letting the weights drop at the bottom

cues: Hold light dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in your elbows
Raise your arms out to the side until they reach shoulder height
Lower slowly instead of dropping them
mistakes: Swinging the weights up with your body
Lifting past shoulder height with your shoulders shrugged

cues: Set a rope at head height and step back until the cable is tight
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly
mistakes: Using too much weight and leaning back
Letting your elbows drop below your hands

cues: Face the pad and set the handles at shoulder height
Sweep your arms back with a slight bend in your elbows
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders
Swinging your torso to move the weight

cues: Hold the band in front of you at shoulder height with your arms straight
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest
Return slowly, keeping tension on the band
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears
Arching your back to get the band wider

cues: Start in a downward-dog shape with your hips high and your legs straight
Lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands
Press back up until your arms are straight
mistakes: Letting your hips sag so it turns into a regular push-up
Flaring your elbows wide

cues: Lie face down with your arms out in a Y shape and your thumbs pointing up
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your upper back
Hold for a second, then lower slowly
mistakes: Lifting with your lower back instead of your upper back
Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears

cues: Stand tall with a shoulder-width grip, palms up
Curl the bar up while keeping your elbows pinned at your sides
Lower fully under control
mistakes: Swinging your torso to lift the weight
Letting your elbows drift forward

cues: Grip the angled parts of the bar with your palms turned slightly inward
Curl up while keeping your elbows at your sides
Lower fully under control
mistakes: Rocking your back to get the bar up
Stopping short at the bottom of each rep

cues: Hold the dumbbells at your sides with your palms facing forward
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows still
Lower slowly until your arms are straight
mistakes: Swinging the dumbbells with your body
Cutting the range short at the bottom

cues: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other
Curl up without turning your wrists
Lower slowly to full extension
mistakes: Letting your elbows drift forward
Using momentum from your shoulders

cues: Set a rope or bar on a high pulley and pin your elbows to your sides
Push down until your arms are fully straight
Let the handle rise slowly until your forearms are just past parallel
mistakes: Leaning over the handle and using your body weight
Letting your elbows flare away from your sides

cues: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead and your arms straight
Lower it behind your head by bending only at the elbows
Extend back up without letting your elbows flare
mistakes: Arching your lower back as you press
Letting your elbows flare far apart

cues: Lie on a flat bench holding the bar over your chest with your arms straight
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead
Extend your arms back up, keeping your upper arms still
mistakes: Letting your elbows flare wide
Moving your upper arms back and forth so it becomes a press

cues: Make a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers under your chest
Keep your body straight and your elbows close to your ribs
Lower until your chest touches your hands, then press up
mistakes: Letting your hips sag
Flaring your elbows out to the sides

cues: Stand on the middle of a towel with one foot and hold both ends
Curl your hands up while pressing your foot down to resist
Hold the top for a second, then lower slowly and keep the tension on
mistakes: Letting the towel go slack at the bottom
Leaning back to lift instead of curling

cues: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it with your feet shoulder-width apart
Sit down and back until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your chest up
mistakes: Letting your knees cave inward
Rounding your lower back at the bottom

cues: Set the bar on your upper back with your feet slightly in front of the bar
Sit down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor
Press up through your heels and mid-foot
mistakes: Placing your feet directly under the bar, which strains your knees
Letting your heels lift off the floor

cues: Hold one dumbbell against your chest with both hands
Sit straight down between your knees, keeping your chest tall
Drive up through your whole foot
mistakes: Letting your chest fall forward
Letting your knees collapse inward

cues: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot
mistakes: Letting your heels rise
Letting your knees cave inward

cues: Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform
Lower until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees
Press through your whole foot without locking your knees at the top
mistakes: Letting your lower back lift off the seat
Locking your knees hard at the top

cues: Set the pad on your lower shins and line your knees up with the machine's pivot
Extend your legs until they are almost straight and squeeze your quads
Lower slowly without letting the weights crash
mistakes: Swinging the weight up with momentum
Lifting your hips off the seat

cues: Adjust the pad so it rests just above your heels
Curl your heels toward your glutes and squeeze
Return slowly to a nearly straight leg
mistakes: Lifting your hips to cheat the weight up
Dropping the weight quickly on the way down

cues: Hold the bar at your thighs with a soft bend in your knees
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs with a flat back
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward
mistakes: Rounding your back to reach lower
Bending your knees more each rep until it becomes a squat

cues: Step one leg back and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down
Push through your front foot to return to standing
mistakes: Letting your front knee cave inward
Taking too short a step so your front knee shoots forward

cues: Rest your rear foot on a bench behind you and stand on your front foot
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor
Drive up through your front heel
mistakes: Standing too close to the bench
Letting your front knee cave inward

cues: Rest your upper back on a bench with the bar across your hips (use a pad)
Drive through your heels until your hips line up with your shoulders and knees
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control
mistakes: Arching your lower back instead of squeezing your glutes
Pushing up on your toes instead of your heels

cues: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly
mistakes: Arching your lower back at the top
Pushing through your toes

cues: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, or on flat ground
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can
Lower slowly until your heels drop below the step
mistakes: Bouncing quickly with no pause at the top
Bending your knees to help

cues: Sit in the leg press with your toes on the bottom edge of the platform and your legs almost straight
Push through the balls of your feet to rise onto your toes
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in your calves
mistakes: Bending your knees to move the weight
Bouncing at the bottom

cues: Stand slightly wider than your shoulders and hinge your hips back with the kettlebell in both hands
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell up to chest height
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat
mistakes: Squatting the movement instead of hinging
Lifting the bell with your arms instead of your hips

cues: Rest on your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders
Keep a straight line from your head to your heels
Squeeze your glutes and breathe steadily
mistakes: Letting your hips sag or pike up
Holding your breath

cues: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line
Keep your hips stacked and hold
mistakes: Letting your hips drop toward the floor
Rolling your chest forward or backward

cues: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat
Curl your ribs toward your hips, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor
Lower slowly without letting your head drop back
mistakes: Pulling on your neck with your hands
Using momentum to swing up

cues: Lie on your back with your arms up and your knees bent over your hips
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor while your lower back stays pressed down
Return and switch sides
mistakes: Letting your lower back arch off the floor
Moving so fast that you lose control

cues: Start in a straight-arm plank with your hands under your shoulders
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs
Keep your hips level and your core tight
mistakes: Bouncing your hips up and down
Letting your hands drift forward of your shoulders

cues: Hang from the bar with your shoulders pulled down
Raise your legs, bent or straight, until your hips curl up
Lower slowly without swinging
mistakes: Swinging your body to gain momentum
Lifting your legs without tilting your pelvis, so your hip flexors do all the work

cues: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head
Curl your ribs toward your hips, rounding your spine
Return slowly without sitting back on your heels
mistakes: Pulling with your arms instead of curling your torso
Sitting your hips back and down

cues: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders and brace your core
Roll out slowly until your body is nearly straight
Pull back in by squeezing your abs, not your hips
mistakes: Letting your lower back sag as you roll out
Going further out than you can control

cues: Set both pulleys high and step forward with one foot ahead, leaning slightly forward
Sweep your hands down and together in front of your hips with your elbows slightly bent
Squeeze your chest at the bottom, then return slowly until you feel a stretch
mistakes: Bending and straightening your elbows so it becomes a press
Rocking your torso to swing the handles

cues: Set up with your chest on the pad, or hinge with a flat back, knees soft
Pull the handle toward your chest, driving your elbows back
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower until your arms are straight
mistakes: Rounding your back to lift more weight
Shrugging your shoulders instead of pulling with your back

cues: Pick an assistance weight that lets you finish every rep with good form
Start by pulling your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the handles
Lower slowly until your arms are straight
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom of the rep
Stopping short of a full stretch at the bottom

cues: Set the pad just below your hip bones and hook your feet under the rollers
Lower your torso with a straight back until you feel a hamstring stretch
Raise back up until your body is in a straight line, no higher
mistakes: Swinging up so far that your lower back over-arches
Rounding your back on the way down

cues: Set a bar or rope on a high pulley, step back and hinge slightly at the hips
With straight arms, sweep the handle down in an arc to your thighs
Return slowly to shoulder height, keeping your arms almost straight
mistakes: Bending your elbows so it turns into a pushdown
Using your body's momentum instead of your lats

cues: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivots
Raise your arms out to the sides until your elbows reach shoulder height
Lower slowly without letting the weights touch down
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up as you lift
Using momentum by leaning back

cues: Hold a plate at the sides of the rim with both hands and your arms straight
Raise it in front of you to shoulder height
Lower slowly under control
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the plate up
Lifting above shoulder height with a shrug

cues: Set the seat so your armpits rest on top of the pad
Curl the bar up without lifting your elbows off the pad
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight
mistakes: Letting the bar drop fast at the bottom
Lifting your chest off the pad to swing the weight up

cues: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot and your arms rest on the pad
Curl the handles up while keeping your upper arms on the pad
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight
mistakes: Lifting your shoulders to help the curl
Letting the weights slam down

cues: Adjust the seat so your elbows sit level with the pivot
Press the handles down until your arms are straight
Return slowly until your forearms are just past parallel
mistakes: Lifting your elbows away from the pad
Bouncing at the top of the rep

cues: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads, feet about shoulder-width apart
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform
Press up through your whole foot without locking your knees
mistakes: Placing your feet too low, so your knees travel far forward
Letting your lower back peel off the pad

cues: Sit with your upper back against the pad and the belt or pad across your hips
Drive through your heels until your hips line up with your shoulders and knees
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control
mistakes: Arching your lower back at the top
Pushing through your toes instead of your heels

cues: Sit tall with your back against the pad and your legs against the outer pads
Press your legs out to the sides in a smooth motion
Bring them back slowly without letting the weights touch
mistakes: Leaning forward and swinging the weight
Using so much weight that your range of motion shrinks

cues: Sit tall with your legs apart and your inner thighs against the pads
Squeeze your legs together in a smooth motion
Let them open slowly to a comfortable stretch
mistakes: Opening your legs wider than is comfortable
Jerking the weight to start each rep

cues: Set the pads on your shoulders (or your lap, if seated) with the balls of your feet on the platform
Rise onto your toes as high as you can and pause
Lower slowly until you feel a deep calf stretch
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom
Bending your knees to help lift

cues: Lie on your back with your heels on the ball and your hips lifted
Bend your knees to roll the ball toward your glutes
Straighten your legs slowly, keeping your hips up
mistakes: Letting your hips drop as you roll the ball
Rushing the return so the ball shoots away

cues: Set the seat so the pivot lines up with your waist, then hold the handles or pad
Curl your ribs toward your hips, rounding your spine
Return slowly without letting the weights rest
mistakes: Pulling with your arms instead of your abs
Using so much weight that your hips lift

cues: Stand tall and raise the ball overhead, rising onto your toes (a non-bouncing slam ball is best)
Brace your core and slam the ball down hard in front of you
Squat to pick it up and repeat
mistakes: Bending forward from your lower back instead of your hips and knees
Standing so close that the ball bounces back at you
